indicator.title: Handelsintensität
indicator.description: Summe aus Exporten und Importen von Gütern und Dienstleistungen in Prozent des BIP.

source.sourceNote: Trade is the sum of exports and imports of goods and services. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.
